title: Output of the scenario-scene agent: the plans of ONE scene

plans.description: The scene's plans, in reading order. Order is that of the array: no plan number.

titre.description: (French) Distinct from every other plan's title.

description.description: (French) The plan's intent, precise and complete: where the characters who matter start (relative to fixed landmarks of the place), the beats in order with visible gestures, what changes during the plan, how it ends (its last beat), and why it exists; then the lines said (each `NAME : « exact text »` on its own line, in the dialogue language). Narrative, with no framing, sound or camera movement, light only when it changes in the plan, no reference to another plan, no « État en fin de plan » line.

liaison.description: How this plan links to the PREVIOUS one (for the first plan: to the previous scene's last plan). suite: it takes up where the previous plan ends (same place, same moment or seconds later, same people where the previous plan's last beat left them; its render continues the previous one without a cut). coupe: a clean cut (another place, another moment, another point of view). The first plan of the episode is a coupe. When unsure: coupe.

dureeSecondes.description: Generation duration, whole seconds, from 4 to 10 (never less than 4). It follows the brief's rhythm and the scene's genre; group close moments into a single plan. A dialogue plan: generous duration, breathing margin of at least 2 s.

inventions.description: (French) Everything that was not in the brief nor the treatment. To validate or throw out.

notes.description: (French) Risky plans, a dialogue too long for the scene. Empty if nothing to report.
